name: Plant control system
description: Plant control system for the 7-unit gas-engine generator plant and SESB 132/33/11 kV connection. Procurement / I&C. BOQ quantities and dimensions are design inputs, not sourced facts.

specifications.metric: Valmet DNA automation system (SESB ref — integrated control scope
specifications.basis: Valmet press release, 'Valmet to supply automation technology to Sabah Electricity's power plant in Malaysia', Valmet Oyj press release 1 July 2016 at 11:00 a.m. EET, read directly. (value: boiler, feedwater and turbine control integrated into one Valmet DNA platform)

vendor_models.line: ABB Ability System 800xA (DCS with High Integrity SIS)
Valmet DNA automation system (SESB reference platform)

sources.note: 112 MWe combined cycle plant, three gas turbines plus one steam turbine; Valmet DNA replacing existing automation; local partner PESTECH Technology; TNB Remaco on GE gas turbine interface.
958 MW two single-shaft CCGT units; Omnivise T3000 DCS integrates turbines, black start unit, electrical houses and planned battery storage; up to 200 starts per year stated.

notes: Analysed core item from the owner-supplied equipment/facilities list for a 7-unit gas-engine power plant. Evidence categories present: sources, specifications, vendors, catalogue models. Checked for prices, projects, standards, patents, drawings and materials; where absent the gaps record says so.
